title: Florencia Colazo · Information Systems Analyst | Full Stack Developer

name: Florencia Colazo
skill: Information Systems Analyst | Full Stack Developer
headline: I turn real business problems into *software people use every day.*
tagline: Systems Analyst and full stack developer. I understand the business, design the solution and ship it: from the first conversation to a working system.
available: Open to a junior role (preferably remote) and new projects
about: I'm an Information Systems Analyst and an advanced student of the Bachelor's in Information Systems. Before coding, I spent over ten years on the other side of the counter: serving customers, selling and running a store. That taught me something you don't learn at university: understand what people need before writing a single line of code. Today I build complete systems, from requirements and data modeling to the interface and deployment: two of them are used every day by a company with 4,000 active customers. I develop with AI assistance (Claude Code, Antigravity) and I'm looking for a junior Full Stack, Backend or Frontend Developer, or Data Analyst role, preferably remote.

process.title: I understand the problem
process.text: I gather requirements by talking to the people who will use the system, not just the ones who ask for it.

process.title: I design the solution
process.text: I model the data, define the flows and sketch the interface before writing code.

process.title: I build end to end
process.text: Frontend, backend and database, with clean, maintainable code.

process.title: I ship and stay involved
process.text: I deploy, train the team and keep improving the system based on real use.
